data.title: An information panel at Hatné – the fortlets of Hatňanská Skala and Hrádek
data.excerpt: On a sunny autumn Saturday, 16 November 2013, our civic association Hradiská put up an information panel beside the two fortlets at Hatné – Hatňanská Skala and Hrádek. The text of the panel was checked by Mgr. Jozef Moravčík, for several decades the archaeologist of the Žilina museum.

children.text: On 16 November 2013, on a sunny autumn Saturday, our
undertook another action – the installation of an information panel beside the fortlets at Hatné (Hatňanská Skala and Hrádek).

The text of the information panel was checked for us on the specialist side by Mgr. Jozef Moravčík, who worked for several decades as the archaeologist of the Žilina museum and who in the past also carried out a great many archaeological excavations in the Mariková valley.
The weather, as at our previous events, again favoured us. Our invitation to take part in the unveiling of the panel was accepted by
the mayor of the village of Hatné, Mgr. Iveta Žilovcová.
and the members of his former archaeology club
Martin Olšovský, Dr. Stanislav Miko and Gašpar Zemančík

. Štefan Meliš and Ladislav Janech had to decline because of health problems, although very reluctantly. Besides them, representatives of Matica slovenská came, and a number of other people to whom our history is not a matter of indifference.
 
 The mayor was most helpful to us, both in that together with

(on behalf of the village) she took part in funding the panel, and in arranging the technical side of its installation in the grounds of the new recreation area at Hatné, which lies precisely between the two fortlets. She has our great thanks for her cooperation and helpfulness.

children.text: At the ceremonial unveiling of the panel, Mr Moravčík himself gave us an engaging account of the history of both fortlets, and the mayor of the village of Hatné also gave a speech.
Then – fortified by the good feeling of work done and by old Slavic mead – we set off together into the field to visit both fortlets.

With that we closed the “panel season” for 2013, and we are already looking forward to next year, for which four further panels have already been agreed and discussed in advance. If you would like us to install a panel in your town or village as well, where there is a hillfort (preferably one that we already have on the website), and you are willing to help us with the organisation (above all with obtaining the consent of the landowners and funding from sponsors or municipal authorities), do get in touch with us. 
 
 Photographs by: Dr. Stanislav Miko, Sammi, Stanka, Orgoň
